calls.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one separate full-body transparent walking animation frame for Scarlet, porcelain DOLL FORM, Silent Hill Homecoming, matching the provided existing game-project sprite.
Input image: strict character, material, proportions and side-view reference. Preserve the tall two-legged porcelain doll with the same cracked pale ceramic shell, red seams/patina, long articulated arms, segmented hips/knees/ankles, bald sculpted head and fixed snarling face. This is the intact doll phase, NOT the later exposed/spider phase.
Primary request: a clearly different PASSING STEP pose facing RIGHT in an exact side-on fighting-game view. Her weight is on the planted front/rightmost foot. The other foot is lifted a little and passes forward beneath the hip with its knee bent. Keep the two legs distinct, no crossing through each other, same giant proportions. The long arms counter-swing gently, hands open, fingers long and complete; they are not attacking. Upper body leans slightly forward but is still upright.
Composition: one character, one pose. Scale the entire character down within the canvas so there is at least 12 percent clear transparent padding from the top of the head, bottoms of the soles, and all fingertips to the image edges. Full silhouette from head to toes and fingertips. No tight crop. Center within the middle 76 percent of the canvas.
Rendering: detailed realistic 2D game character render consistent with the reference; ceramic surfaces remain ceramic, no new flesh injuries, no new gore, no clothing or weapon added.
Transparency: genuine clean alpha; remove the reference's ambient brown haze so only the doll is visible. No background, ground, cast shadow, smoke, vignette, glow, outline or text. No sheet and no second character.
calls.reason: Replaced by alpha-edge refinement; most apparent preview haze already had alpha zero.

calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Target: this Scarlet porcelain doll sprite in a side-facing walking contact pose.
Change only the gait pose to the OPPOSITE contact. Keep the exact same head, porcelain material, scale, limb lengths, camera facing RIGHT, canvas framing and complete silhouette.
Critical leg order: the NEAR leg (closest to the viewer, its thigh currently visible across the foreground going toward screen-right) must instead extend BACKWARD toward SCREEN-LEFT with its heel slightly raised. The FAR leg must extend FORWARD toward SCREEN-RIGHT with its foot planted. The far thigh is naturally partly occluded by the near thigh at the hip; do not fuse the legs. This is a true alternating stride, not the same leading leg in a wider stance.
Counter-swing: the NEAR arm moves a little forward toward screen-right while the far arm drifts back; preserve both complete long hands and all fingers, no attack.
Everything else stays the same. Entire doll visible with transparent margins; no added background, haze, ground, shadow, glow, outlines, text, weapon or new damage. Actual clean transparent alpha outside the doll, including all gaps.

calibration: New heads are about 94% of the original source-pixel size. Shared bodyHeight .86 retains their standing-equivalent stature while allowing the bent/wide stride to lower the body. Vertical anchors follow actual lowest visible sole at alpha>=32; horizontal anchor aligns pelvis relative to old idle.
